name: voice-workbench
description: 本地语音工作台：网易 Confucius4-TTS 主服务（免转写克隆 / 14 语种）+ GPT-SoVITS 本地辅助（推理/训练/批量合成）+ MiMo 云端

scripts.install:all: npm install --no-fund --no-audit && npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n netease,sovits,server,app -c green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:netease -- --skip-if-missing" "npm run dev:sovits -- --no-open" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix app run dev"
scripts.dev:cloud: concurrently -n server,app -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix app run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix app run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.preview: npm run build && concurrently -n sovits,server -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev:sovits -- --no-open" "npm --prefix server run start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
